messages:
sara_support: FYI — support ticket #C-22481. Customer pasted this error: \"Free trial creation blocked: risk_hold\". They say they used promo code but never got trial. Customer message (copied): \"I registered with j***@temp-mail.org and got blocked immediately. I need the trial to evaluate Redwood for a POC.\"

fraud-bot: Auto-hold applied by rule `trial_abuse_v2` — reasons: email_domain=tempmail.org (on disposable list), ip_asn=PROXY_ASN_3344 (seen in proxy list), account_age_secs=1800, velocity=3_accounts_24h.

mike_fraud: dropping in. Quick checklist: 1) confirm IP & ASN (we have 45.77.12.3 -> ASN 3344 flagged), 2) check recent cards/pmts, 3) look for matching device fingerprints. If sales says high-value acct we can manual-review.

jamal_csm: Heads-up — user says they represent a startup evaluating infra for a pilot. Sales asked for an expedited manual review if low risk. Can we do a one-time trial grant pending fraud ops confirmation? :pray:

olivia_eng: If fraud ops approves, support can flip the trial flag via admin UI or API. Admin API snippet (internal):

```
POST /internal/admin/users/12345/actions
Content-Type: application/json
{
  "action": "grant_trial",
  "reason": "manual_review_sales_approve",
  "expires_in_days": 14
}
```

mike_fraud: I'm running the lookup now: `./tools/fraud_lookup --email j***@temp-mail.org --ip 45.77.12.3` -> result: disposable_email=true, ip_proxy_score=0.82, linked_accounts=2 (same payment token seen twice). Given linked payment tokens, I'd lean conservative.

sara_support: Thanks — replied to customer asking for: 1) try signing up with a non-temporary email (Gmail/Outlook/etc), 2) confirm last 4 of payment method used (we only need to match), 3) a quick note on intended use (POC details). Asked for a response within 48h.

jamal_csm: If they can provide a corporate email or match billing last4, we can probably grant trial. If not, we need fraud sign-off. Sales says time-sensitive.

mike_fraud: If they come back with a non-temp email and payment last4 that matches our token, I'll clear and mark `fraud:low` and you can proceed. If they try to bypass with VPN again, we'll keep hold. Also flagged two recent signups from same IP range — monitoring.

olivia_eng: Note for support: when you flip `grant_trial` via API, it creates an audit event and increments risk watchlist count. If you want a silent grant (no watch), we have `grant_trial_no_audit` but that's restricted to fraud_ops leads.

sara_support: Got it. I'll log back once customer replies. Marking thread pending fraud verification and possible manual override by fraud_ops. :white_check_mark:
